title: Failure-type-aware generative augmentation: evaluation code, predictions, and results
description: Code, the complete archived predictions (30 repeated stratified splits x 8 strategies), and every result table and figure for the article 'Codifying Failure Knowledge for Industrial Decision Support: An Evaluation of Failure-Type-Aware Generative Augmentation' (Interdisciplinary Journal of Information, Knowledge, and Management). The study compares a cost-sensitive baseline, random undersampling, SMOTE, SMOTENC, Borderline-SMOTE, ADASYN, single-generator WGAN-GP augmentation and failure-type-aware WGAN-GP augmentation (one generator per failure mechanism) on the AI4I 2020 benchmark under a leakage-safe protocol. The dataset itself is not included.
